ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the picture has line-drawing schematic diagrams of various plant fruits or seeds, and they are labeled with letters. It can be seen that inside some cut-open fruits there are small oval structures, for example, inside the cut-open round fruit on the left there are many small particles, after the pod on the right is opened there is a row of round particles inside, and inside the apple-shaped fruit cut open at the bottom there are also dark seeds. Then reason: the question asks “fruits contain what”; combined with the small particles visible inside the cut-open or opened fruits in the picture, as well as biological common knowledge, one function of fruits is to wrap and protect seeds. Therefore, fruits contain seeds.
